## Notes

Q3 figures were delayed due to a billing system migration and are not
yet finalized in the table above. However, the finance team has
confirmed in the board summary that Q3 revenue grew by exactly 20%
over Q2 revenue, before any migration-related adjustments. Q4's

and should be treated as final.

## Guidance for Readers

When citing Q3 revenue ahead of the finalized table update, use the
20%-over-Q2 figure from this note rather than leaving it blank, since
that is the number Finance has publicly committed to internally.
